Installation index

Reading a gauge

A rain gauge needs a level mounting surface and a clear path to the sky. Place the cylinder away from fences or rooftops that could divert water into the collector. Record the water level at the same time each day.

Convert a measurement

Keep the measured amount as a decimal value and round the final result only when writing a report. The example reads a measurement in millimetres and expresses the depth in metres. 

depth = millimetres / 1000
